batting.dismissal: c Kartik Sharma b Noor Ahmad

batting.dismissal: c Gurjapneet Singh b Noor Ahmad

batting.name: AR Patel
batting.dismissal: c AJ Hosein b Gurjapneet Singh

batting.name: T Stubbs
batting.dismissal: c Mukesh Choudhary b J Overton

balls.text: Kamboj has proved costly at the death! Rizvi once again moves towards the off side and this time launches the wide and full ball over the head of the fielder at long off! DC finish with 155 ... and though they finished well, CSK should be quite happy with this target.

run out at the bowler's end after a direct hit from Gaikwad! Ashutosh hit the ball into the pitch, it bounced up and Kamboj got a hand on it to deflect it to Gaikwad who did the rest as they attempted a risky single

all the way over the point boundary! Ashutosh moves across his crease towards the off side really early, Kamboj goes wider outside off to counter Ashutosh's movement, the batter then takes the ball on the full and slices the ball over point, hits the advertising toblerones on the full

tries to hit a wide ball against the angle through the leg side and gets a bottom edge into the pitch, they run a quick single and Kamboj misses the penalty at the striker's end as he tries to run the batter out with his boot
Kamboj persists with the wide line, Ashutosh moves to the off and tries to swing the ball through midwicket, gets an inside edge on to his leg

Kamboj is getting hit in this manner repeatedly now, this time it's Ashutosh moving across his crease to counter the angle across him from around the wicket, taking the ball on the full and swinging it over the long leg boundary
moves across his stumps and guides the ball to long leg, Overton's first over is a good one for CSK, better late than never? Or should have got him on much earlier?
smashed straight to long leg! Stubbs nails the pull hard and flat but not high enough, Mukesh gets behind the catch on the edge of the boundary

that's miles in the air, absolutely miles, and when it lands, no one goes for the catch. Rizvi tried to flick a full ball and got a leading edge that sent the ball into orbit, but not very far down the ground. It was coming down somewhere between the bowler and mid-on. Overton behind to go for the catch himself but it was swirling so much that he decided to leave it for ruturaj, who had decided to leave it for Overton
short of a length again, Stubbs pulls along the ground to deep midwicket
short of a length, the heavy ball, Rizvi slices the pull in the air and it falls short of Gaikwad running in from mid off
short of a length at the stumps, Stubbs swings across the line to deep square leg
Rizvi does it again! Moving across his crease towards the off side to take the ball on the full toss and swat it high over the fine leg boundary
bowled full and wide outside off from around the wicket, Stubbs reaches for it from his crease and bottom edges it into the ground
moves across his crease again and plays through cover point, Kamboj bowled that really wide

makes great contact this time to bring up the 50 stand! Rizvi moves across his crease towards the off side, with Kamboj aiming for the full and wide ball, he picks up the ball on the full and swats it over the backward square leg boundary
bowled wide of the right-hander from around the wicket, Rizvi reaches for it but can't make contact again
angles it across the right-hander, aiming for the wide yorker, Rizvi tries to shovel it past short third but misses
flicked off the pads through midwicket for a single to end the over
nearly in the blockhole again, line is slightly wider, played into the covers
in the blockhole on off stump, dug out back to the bowler
a low full toss, driven from the crease towards mid off
nudged off the pads towards midwicket for a single
sprayed too wide outside off from around the wicket
there's Jamie Overton, with a sensational save on the long off boundary, sprinting to his right and sliding and pulling the ball back in with one hand, that was driven quite powerfully by Stubbs
slower one angling outside off, played off the back foot through point
fuller length to compensate for the previous one, driven to long off for a single
Rizvi saw that coming, he was across his stumps really early, getting inside the line of a short ball and hoisting it high and far over the fine leg boundary
worked off the pads through midwicket for a single
Rizvi clears his front foot and slaps the length ball to deep point
rides the bounce on the back foot and cuts behind point as the short of a length ball angles across him from over the wicket
too wide outside off, first wide of the innings? First extra in fact!
skiddy ball into the right-hander from around the wicket, played off the back foot to long on
worked off the pads in front of square leg
hit down the ground to long off
Urvil's not stopping this though, Noor gives Stubbs width and time to go back and lash the cut short hard, beating Urvil to his right on the point boundary
too short, Stubbs goes back and punches the ball hard through the covers, Urvil covers a lot of ground on the boundary and dives to his right to save runs
goes back and punches past the bowler to long on
dabbed from the crease towards cover point for a single
goes back and nudges off the hips through midwicket

that's a massive hit, in the upper tiers! Stubbs moved a fraction towards the off, cleared his front foot and swung through the line, to launch a length ball on the up high and far over long on, 93 metres
dabbed off the front foot to mid off for a single
short of a length on middle and off, Stubbs swivels and swats through square leg
length ball on middle and off from over the wicket, Stubbs stays in his crease and plays into the covers
punched into the covers and can't beat the infield, they scamper through for a single though ... the players are taking a time out
punched to mid-on and they take on Gaikwad's throw, he misses at the bowler's end
cut hard but can't beat the fielder at backward point, there was width to cash in on
defended back to the bowler
short of a length from over the wicket, Stubbs clears his front foot and pulls to deep midwicket
chipped in the air and the bowler dives full length to his right, fell just short of him
stops and spins away from the right-hander, Stubbs does well to play late and check his shot, hitting it back to the bowler, that's Akeal done for the innings
leans forward to a slow one angling into him and drives to long off
goes back and punches to long on for one more
punched off the back foot into the covers, Akeal getting through his final over swiftly and economically
tossed up outside leg stump, nudged in front of square leg
played off the pads to deep midwicket
spooned to cover and there's no dropping this! Short of a length delivery outside off, grips the pitch a touch and stops of Axar who drives a touch too early and lobs the catch to Hosein
Axar fails to connect properly and bottom edges the shot into the off side
slower one angling across the right-hander, pushed gently towards mid off
played into the covers from the crease
dismissed into the stands! Short ball in response to that drop and Stubbs swivels and pulls over the long leg boundary, commanding shot
dropped in the covers by Noor diving to his right, a straightforward chance even though Stubbs drove that firmly, he tried to hit it on the up and is lucky to survive
bottom edges a cut into the ground to backward point
bowled full and straight into the right hander from around the wicket, played off the pads between midwicket and mid-on
Brevis dives to his right and cuts off a firm push from Stubbs to keep him on strike

swept straight to the fielder at deep backward square, DC are crumbling! Fairly ordinary ball, a bit too short and Rana was down on one knee and waiting, he simply hit it in the air and flat, straight to Kartik Sharma
this time he cashes in on the width on offer, moving back and slapping the wide ball past the diving fielder at cover
cuts hard and misses as the ball zips past him wide outside off stump
good length on middle and leg, Axar leans across and nudges to midwicket, five off the over, DC going nowhere
fuller length close to off stump, Rana tries to cut hard but gets a bottom edge into the ground near his feet, the ball goes towards point
nudged off the pads behind square for a single
stays back and steers a length ball from outside off to deep third
short of a length with some lift into the left-hander, Axar stays back and plays on the off side
pushed from the crease to long on for a single, moved across and gave it a bit of a flick
whoops, he's hit that straight to short fine leg, soft dismissal as they say, got down on one knee to sweep and lapped it straight to Gurjapneet
leans forward and drives the ball drifting into him to long on
nudged to long on from the crease for a single
goes back to punch through point but gets a thick edge to short third
drops it a bit too short and Nair is back in a flash to cut late, beating the fielder at backward point diving to his left
full length from over the wicket, Rana gets down on one knee, right across his stumps, and sweeps behind square leg
moves right across his stumps and scoops a low full toss from off stump over short fine leg for a boundary
gets squared up by a length ball angling across him and the outside edge runs to deep third
this time Nair makes contact and steers the length ball to deep third
good length just outside off and the ball holds its line and beats the outside edge of Nair's poke with an angled bat face
fuller ball on the pads, Nair plays a chippy-flick in the air and into the gap on the square leg boundary, the fielder runs to his right to cut it off
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Nair gets behind it and punches towards mid-on
slides the ball across the left-hander and Rana stays in his crease and dabs towards point, top powerplay for CSK, DC barely going at a run a ball.
goes back and taps the ball to mid on for a single
nudged from the crease towards backward point
bowled full into the right-hander from around the wicket, Nair clips it to midwicket
Karun Nair nudges his first ball off the pads to square leg

it's Gaikwad under the skier and he holds on at mid-off! Hosein slowed it up and got the ball to turn away as Rahul advanced and aimed to go big down the ground, he was beaten in the flight and ended up mis-hitting it high into the air, Gaikwad judged that well
moves forward and towards the off side and opens the face to steer to short third
shot! A sweet punch on the up through covers, just wide of the fielder diving to his left in the in field
steps out of his crease to whip a fullish ball on the leg side but gets a thick inside edge behind square leg
played off the pads to midwicket, Kamboj is keeping it wicket to wicket
just short of a length outside off, Rana hangs back and slaps it through point
played from the crease towards square leg, good length and the line was around off and middle

taken by Brevis at mid-on! Pace-off from Mukesh on a good length and Nissanka was through the shot too early, he wanted to clobber that over the leg side but ended up spooning it to Brevis, who back-pedalled from mid-on to take a simple catch
some interest from CSK for a caught behind but once again they don't review ... fuller and wider from Mukesh, Nissanka reaches for it without moving his feet and misses, bat might have hit ground

first six of the game, and it comes via a lap scoop, Nissanka moves across towards the off side, anticipating a fuller length correction from Mukesh and makes great contact to send the ball over the fine leg boundary
now Nissanka expects the one angling away, after so many bent back in, stands still in his crease and frees his arms to cash in on the width on offer, cutting the ball to the backward point boundary
this time he pings the ball away from the right hander from over the wicket, short of a length and slanting away, Nissanka has a slash and misses
swings across the line at a fullish ball swinging back into him and gets a thick inside edge to midwicket
he's got it through the gap at backward point! Hosein pushed that through a little flatter just outside off, Rahul was back in a flash to cut the ball late and between two fielders in that region
pitches around off and spins away from Rahul, who goes back and punches into the covers
checks his shot as the ball spins across him and plays it back to the bowler, gets squared up a touch
the arm-ball slides into Rahul on a good length, he stays in his crease and hits the ball to cover
darts it into the right-hander from around the wicket, Nissanka pushes off  the back foot to mid on and runs a quick single
angles into the right-hander, shorter length, Rahul goes back and flat-bats it towards mid off
full again with more swing into the right-hander, Nissanka gives it a thump off the front foot but can't beat mid-off with the drive
fuller length swinging back into Nissanka who pushes forward and plays into the off side
short of a length at the body, Rahul gets a bottom edge down near his feet and responds to Nissanka's call for a quick single
shortens his length a bit and the line is straighter too with shape into the right-hander, Rahul brings his bat down across his pad and plays on the leg side
too full this time, and Rahul leans forward and cover drives through the gap in the infield to pick up his first boundary of the match
a fullish ball angling across the right-hander and shaping back in a touch, Rahul plays into the covers
played to mid-on ... nervy start from Nissanka
streaky, past the first slip and to the deep third boundary, Nissanka backed away to play through point and ended up slicing the arm ball

a slightly quicker one to follow two slower ones and a loud appeal for lbw after Nissanka goes back in his crease and gets squared up as the ball spins across him and hit the back leg, the umpire says not out and CSK decide not to review, might have been high
some grip and turn on the surface, played on the off side from the crease
pitches around off and spins away, pushed into the off side
strays on to the pads first up and Nissanka gets down low and unleashes a fierce sweep shot that races pastvthe fielder at backward square leg and to the boundary

ends the game with a short-arm pull to a short of a length ball, beating mid-on to his left and racing to the boundary, CSK stay in sixth place but are now only two points behind four teams from Nos. 2 to 5
Kartik levels the scores by launching the ball over the long-on boundary, it was a length ball and he got under it and swung hard
swings hard across the line and misses the short of a length ball

tries to go big down the ground but mis-times the shot, mid-off was up though and Axar had to track back a long way and the ball fell out of his reach, he managed to pull it in just inside the boundary
glanced off the pads behind square for a single
low full toss outside off, driven to deep point
pushed into the off side for a single
full ball around off stump, Kartik goes inside out, lofting over the infield and into the gap on the boundary
fired into the blockhole from around the wicket, angling into the right-hander, Kartik opens the face and steers it to deep third
slower ball on a good length, Samson wanted to steer it towards point but ended up playing it back to the bowler
short of a length ball sits up wide outside off, Karthik stands tall and forehands it towards wide long off
Ngidi responds with one in the blockhole that Samson digs out to short fine leg
half-volley outside off and Samson nails the cover drive, perfect timing and placement ... 17 needed for a hundred, 20 to win
full ball on the pads, swung hard through square leg but hasn't timed it well
the slower full toss wide outside off, Kartik reaches for it and misses as the ball dips on him and out of reach, the umpire calls it wide
Karthik gets into the act now, moving across his stumps a long way, getting down low, and scooping to the fine leg boundary
full toss outside off, Samson swings hard at it but mis-times the shot, chipping the ball over the fielder at cover
full ball angling across the right-hander and Samson swings across the line, hitting it along the ground and into the gap on the midwicket boundary

Samson is closing the gap in some style! Leans into a full ball and drills it hard and far over the wide long-off boundary, that was pace-off from Natarajan with width and Samson threw his hands at it and lofted it so cleanly
short of a length and pulled, pulled well enough to clear the fielder on the edge of the deep square leg boundary
pulled through midwicket for a single
short of a length ball and straight, Samson clears his front foot and flat-bats it past the bowler, but hasn't timed it well enough to reach the boundary, I think Samson might have hit that twice ...
there's a slower one, wide outside off, Karthik lets it go hoping to get a wide call in his favour, just the single off that over
pace-on, this one is in the blockhole and Samson digs it out behind square on the leg side, Ngidi's bowled very, very few slower ones today
make that four, Samson reaches for a wide one and cuts to backward point
short of a length wide outside off, it stops on Samson a touch as he tries to hit it through covers, finds the fielder
fuller length on off and middle, punched back to the bowler
an appeal for lbw after Samson misses the flick and gets hit on the pad but only Ngidi is really interested, that was too high
played off the pads to midwicket
driven through cover point from the crease for a single
good length from over the wicket, played from the creae to backward point
played off the back foot to backward point
he's moving up the gears now! Reaching away from his body for a full ball from over the wicket and opening the face to steer to the deep third boundary
sweet drive! Samson stays so still in his crease, waits for Starc to angle the length ball across him and cover drives with plenty of bottom hand to the boundary
in the air but falls short of Kuldeep, pushed at it off the back foot
slows it up again and bowls a fuller length, Samson leans into the drive to long off to bring up a half-century off 32 balls ... he's done superbly on a pitch not easy for batting
Kuldeep tries to bowl a really quick ball, was that a seam up delivery? But the line is down leg side and Samson helps it along to the fine leg boundary
Kuldeep responds with a flatter and quicker ball but the result is still six! This time Samson rocks back and pulls, flat over the deep midwicket boundary
Samson goes big down the ground! He plants his foot forward to the flighted ball and lofts cleanly high and far over the long on boundary
goes back and punches the ball to long off for a single
goes back and works the ball off the pads through midwicket
defended on the off side
punched to long off for a single
goes back and works the ball to long on
cuts the ball firmly off the back foot to deep point
Axar's bowling out ... Samson plays the first one back to the bowler from the crease
tossed up on off and middle, pushed to mid off for a single
steps out of his crease and works the ball towards wide long on
bowled it flat through the air outside off and beats the outside edge
defended back to the bowler

oh my my, what a shot that is over extra cover! Tossed up from Kuldeep, Kartik clears his front foot, gets under the ball and swings hard and clean, getting enough height and distance to clear the boundary
skids the ball through from over the wicket, past the forward prod from Kartik, Rahul takes off the bails but the batter is safe
reaches for the full and wide one this time and times the cover drive to perfection, beating the fielder running to his right from deep point
what a shot that is, he's pulled the short of a length ball past the bowler to the straight boundary, strong-armed it down the ground
short of a length slanting across Samson who tries to cut and is beaten
played from the crease in front of point for a single
cut towards short third and Kartik wants one, Samson does not, Kartik has to dive to make his ground but the throw misses the stumps
short of a length from over the wicket, angling across the right-hander, Kartik bottom edges the cut into the ground
bowled fuller and straighter pushed off the front foot towards Kuldeep's right
a bit too short again and Samson cashes in, rocking back and pulling it flat and over the head of the fielder at deep midwicket
dragged down short and Kartik mows across the line, pulling along the ground, there's a fielder in the deep
presses forward and defends the ball in the air and close on the off side
leans forward and punches to long off for a single
pushed off the pads to midwicket
a touch short and that's all Kartik needs to capitalise, goes back and pulls the ball with power along the ground and into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary
defended with a straight bat on the front foot to the bowler
darts the ball in from around the wicket, angling into the right-hander, defended on the off side

he's been stumped! Urvil came forward a bit too early, Axar shortened his length and zipped the ball through, spinning it past the outside edge of Urvil's attempt to hit down the ground, Rahul had the bails off in a flash. Urvil had dragged his foot out of his crease and it was in the air as he tried to regain his ground when the bails came off
goes back and nudges the ball off the pads through midwicket
played back to the bowler, Axar's on for his second over
he's absolutely blitzed that down the ground, pressing forward and lofting a length ball on the up with an extremely fast bat swing, ends the powerplay with two sixes
he's cleared it this time all right! It's a length ball that keeps a touch low, Urvil moves across his crease and slams the ball with fast hands over the square leg boundary

Will Ashutosh get to it? It's high and very far, he's got so much ground to cover, running to his left from deep midwicket towards long on, and he can't get there in the end. Does well to recover in time after the dive to prevent the boundary. Urvil had launched that very high but not far enough to clear the boundary
pushed off the back foot to mid on for a single
that takes off from just short of a length and beats Samson as he stays back in his crease and tries to steer to deep third
good length angling into the right-hander, punched off the front foot to mid on, pace-on again from Ngidi
steps out and swings to deep midwicket for a single to end a tight over
Urvil backs away and tries to hack the ball through the off side but gets an inside edge behind square
moves outside leg, Axar follows him, Samson waits and checks his shot, punching it wide of the bowler to long off
goes back into the crease and punches into the covers
leans into the delivery from around the wicket and punches to long off
angles the ball into the pads from around the wicket, clipped through square leg
ripper, Test match length outside off, ball holding its line and zipping past the outside edge of Urvil's tentative prod from the crease. Pace-on again.

Gaikwad's game is over, and it's a tame end. He leans across and flicks a good length ball in the air and straight to the fielder at deep square leg. That was a pace-on delivery, Ngidi is yet to bowl a slower one today.
flicked off the pads to square leg where the fielder dives and takes pace off the shot
good length pitching outside off and angling towards middle, Samson pushes off the front foot into the covers
skiddy ball angling into the right-hander, Gaikwad misses the swat and the ball thuds into his thigh and they run a leg bye on the off side
half an appeal for lbw as Gaikwad jams his bat down on an incoming delivery and gets an inside edge on to his front pad
full and wide, Samson flays at it without moving his feet and misses
drops the ball with soft hands close on the off side and sprints through, the fielder runs in and misses with the under arm throw at the striker's end
Gaikwad throws his bat at a wide one and gets a thick edge that flies wide of short third for a boundary ... Gaikwad has got stuck and those runs will be welcome
punched firmly into the covers where another dive takes pace off the ball and deflects it towards deep point
shot! And superbly stopped! Samson opened the face late to punch that ball sweetly towards backward point where Rizvi dived to his right and stopped the ball with one hand, saving four runs
full and much too wide outside off, Samson lets it go
stays still in his crease and opens the face to run a short of a length ball to short third
backs away outside leg, exposing all three stumps and dabs the ball to point
played back to the bowler
backs away outside leg stump, this time Axar follows him by firing the ball down leg side, too wide for Rahul to collect after the batter misses the leg glance
cut off the back foot to point
goes back and punches into the covers where the fielder dives to his right to cut it off, they think about a single and decide against it
played to long off for a single
shot! Samson makes room by moving towards leg and then punches on the up, inside out, high elbow, six over extra cover ... sumptuous
short of a length and slanting across the right-hander, Gaikwad swishes and misses

will DC review the not-out lbw decision? They will! It was a late call. Starc fired the ball in full and straight and bent it back into the right-hander, like he usually does. Samson was late in bringing his bat across his front pad and the ball sped through and thudded into the pad, low down. But ultra edge reveals an inside edge ... Samson will get a run for that as they had scampered a single after the ball went on the leg side
presses forward and opens the face to steer a good length ball through point
fuller length around off, driven into the covers on the front foot but not timed well
short of a length and straighter, Gaikwad stays in his crease and plays to backward point
good length angling across Samson who presses forward and opens the face to drop the ball in front of point for a single
